## Why This Is Asked

Tests the ability to implement tenant-scoped security policies inside a CNF gateway, using Kubernetes ConfigMaps for policy storage and a sidecar for real-time evaluation. It also checks understanding of config reloads and per-request performance.

## Key Concepts

- Tenant-aware policy evaluation and path/method matching
- Sidecar design and ConfigMap-driven policy
- In-memory policy cache and reload semantics
- Path normalization and wildcard handling

## Code Example

```javascript
// Pseudo: evaluatePolicy(tenant, method, path) -> boolean
function evaluatePolicy(tenant, method, path) {
  const rules = policy[tenant] || []
  for (const r of rules) {
    if (r.method === method && (r.path === path || matches(r.path, path))) return true
  }
  return false
}
```

## Follow-up Questions

- How would you handle overlapping rules or wildcard policies across tenants?
- How would you audit and rotate policies without downtime?

## Why This Is Asked
Tests practical runtime policy control, mutation hooks, and tenant isolation in CNF platforms.

- Per-namespace feature gates
- MutatingAdmissionWebhook behavior
- Idempotent patching and rollback

## Code Example
```yaml
# Example flag ConfigMap (cnf-namespace.yaml)
apiVersion: v1
kind: ConfigMap
metadata:
  name: cnf-features
  namespace: tenant-a
data:
  cnf.features.quic.enabled: "true"
```
```yaml
# MutatingWebhookConfiguration skeleton
apiVersion: admissionregistration.k8s.io/v1
kind: MutatingWebhookConfiguration
metadata:
  name: cnf-feature-hook
webhooks:
- name: quic.feature.cnf
  clientConfig:
    service:
      name: cnf-hook-service
      namespace: kube-system
      path: /mutate
  rules:
  - apiGroups: ["apps"]
    apiVersions: ["v1"]
    resources: ["deployments"]
    operations: ["CREATE", "UPDATE"]
  failurePolicy: Fail
  matchPolicy: Equivalent
  timeoutSeconds: 5
  sideEffects: None
```
```yaml
# One-namespace patch to Gateway Deployment (tp-namespace/deploy.yaml)
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Deployment
metadata:
  name: gateway
  namespace: tenant-a
spec:
  template:
    spec:
      containers:
      - name: gateway
        args:
        - --enable-quic
        # This line is injected only when flag is true
```

## Why This Is Asked
Tests ability to implement tenant-scoped feature gating, combining CRDs, policy-as-code, and canary-style risk mitigation in CNF gateways.

## Key Concepts
- FeatureGate CRD and TenantFeatureGate per-tenant
- OPA Gatekeeper: ConstraintTemplate and Constraint
- Path-based canary gating and per-tenant isolation
- Minimal YAML for CRD, policy, namespace, and a basic test

## Code Example
```yaml
# FeatureGate CRD (simplified)
apiVersion: apiextensions.k8s.io/v1
kind: CustomResourceDefinition
metadata:
  name: featuregates.example.org
spec:
  group: example.org
  versions:
    - name: v1
      served: true
      storage: true
      schema:
        openAPIV3Schema:
          type: object
  scope: Namespaced
  names:
    plural: featuregates
    singular: featuregate
    kind: FeatureGate
```

```yaml
# ConstraintTemplate (OPA)
apiVersion: templates.gatekeeper.sh/v1
kind: ConstraintTemplate
metadata:
  name: k8sfeaturegate
spec:
  crd:
    spec:
      names:
        kind: K8sFeatureGate
  targets:
    - target: admission.k8s.gatekeeper.sh
      rego: |
        package k8sfeaturegate
        violation["deny"] {
          input.target.path == "/v1/beta"
          not input.review.object.metadata.annotations["tenant/feature-v1-beta"] == "enabled"
        }
```

```yaml
# Constraint (per-tenant)
apiVersion: constraints.gatekeeper.sh/v1beta1
kind: K8sFeatureGate
metadata:
  name: tenant-v1beta-enabled
spec:
  match:
    kinds:
      - apiGroups: ["gateway.example.org"]
        kinds: ["GatewayRoute"]
  parameters:
    # feature flag key used in tenant annotation
    flagKey: "tenant/feature-v1-beta"
```

```yaml
# Namespace manifest enabling the flag
apiVersion: v1
kind: Namespace
metadata:
  name: tenant-a
  annotations:
    tenant/feature-v1-beta: enabled
```

## Why This Is Asked

# SPIFFE identity configuration
apiVersion: spiffe.example/v1
kind: SPIFFEIdentity
metadata:

spec:

  ttl: 1h
```

# OPA upgrade gate policy
package cnf.upgrade

  input.attestation.trust_score >= 80
  input.sbom.delta.additions == 0

}
```

## Code Example

```yaml
# ConstraintTemplate (yaml)
apiVersion: templates.gatekeeper.sh/v1beta1
kind: ConstraintTemplate
metadata:
  name: cnfnamespacesecurity
spec:
  crd:
    spec:
      names:
        kind: CNFNamespaceSecurityConstraint
        listKind: CNFNamespaceSecurityConstraintList
        plural: cnfnamespacesecurityconstraints
        singular: cnfnamespacesecurityconstraint
  targets:
  - target: admissionreviews
    rego: |
      package cnfnamespacesecurity
      violation[{"msg": msg}] {
        input.review.kind.kind == "Pod"
        some i
        input.review.object.spec.containers[i].securityContext.hostNetwork
        msg := "hostNetwork is forbidden for CNFs"
      }
      violation[{"msg": msg}] {
        input.review.kind.kind == "Pod"
        not input.review.object.spec.containers
        # fallback for non-pods
      }
      violation[{"msg": msg}] {
        some i
        input.review.object.spec.containers[i].securityContext.readOnlyRootFilesystem != true
        msg := "readOnlyRootFilesystem is required for all containers"
      }
      violation[{"msg": msg}] {
        input.review.object.spec.containers[i].securityContext.privileged == true
        msg := "privileged containers are disallowed"
      }
```

```yaml

apiVersion: cnfnamespacesecurity.k8s.io/v1beta1
kind: CNFNamespaceSecurityConstraint
metadata:
  name: cnf-a-security
spec:
  namespace: cnf-a
```

```yaml

apiVersion: v1
kind: Pod
metadata:
  name: compliant-cnf
spec:
  containers:
  - name: app

      readOnlyRootFilesystem: true
      privileged: false
      runAsNonRoot: true
      allowPrivilegeEscalation: false
```

```yaml

kind: Pod
metadata:

spec:
  hostNetwork: true

  - name: app

      privileged: true
```

## Code Example
```yaml
apiVersion: chaosmesh.org/v1alpha1
kind: ChaosExperiment
metadata:
  name: tenant-a-pod-chaos
  namespace: tenant-a
spec:
  definitionRef:
    name: pod-chaos
  duration: 30s
  selector:
    namespaces:
      - tenant-a
    labelSelectors:
      - app=cnf-gateway
      - tenant=tenant-a
```
